result.summary: REQ-ANALYST round 2: REQ-006 reworked in docs/requirements.yaml per step-00b findings and ORCH rulings. The header, title and original_request (lines 159-185) are byte-identical to round 1 (cmp and a ruby comparison). The description (186-269) and criteria (271-288, now 18) were rewritten. YAML parses (ruby Psych, REQ-001..006), and all 18 criteria end with «Проверка:». No «по существу», «оформление» or «третий по счёту» remains. The two «план владельца, п. 3» citations support only «отклонил — сразу рано». A dry run on scratch data showed the new commands work: the AC4 value-line checks on a synthetic brief (1 line, 18 words, 1 terminal mark, 5/5 strings, 1 heading, header row found), the M1 grep (3/3), and the B3 grep on a current snapshot (0; old pattern 9). New AC15 (task descriptions under frozen mandates) shifts the former AC15-17 to AC16-18; AC16 references criteria 4 and 7-13 and «кроме последнего» (= AC18). Open questions: (1) with no rework at the gate, the 60-word limit and the five required strings decide the outcome; the owner may widen them (description 233-235 marks them as the analyst numbers). (2) AC15 fixes literal phrases ORCH must put into task.description; ORCH may want to copy them from AC15 verbatim to avoid a false FAIL. Re-validation: new step-00b-req-validator-r2.json.
